caption: The drawing depicts two gray stoneware jars placed side by side, each with a rounded body, wide opening, and decorative blue designs. The jar on the left is shown with two side handles extending outward near the rim and features a horizontal decorative band of swirling blue patterns around the upper middle section of the body. The jar on the right is depicted with a single handle positioned on the front, arching downward from the rim to the body, and is decorated with similar swirling blue motifs; it also displays the number "2" in blue beneath the handle. Both jars show subtle horizontal lines indicative of their thrown pottery construction, and the background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Crock
